S1K.description: S1, kicks at the two-level rate (Poisson)

S2K.description: S2, independent running waves (no interference), kicks

S2R.description: S2 by the multilevel rate model (independent beams): checks S2K and gives the depumping

S2QR.description: S2Q, multilevel rate model (Doppler, optical pumping, Zeeman, light shifts; no ground coherences)

S2QZ.description: S2Q rate model with z frozen: the best any z-only cooling (sub-Doppler included) can do

S2QV.description: S2Q rate model without z Doppler shifts: z friction cancelled
